cells.en: I'm about to leave the house.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك مغادرة المنزل.
cells.description: Adult ready to step through a doorway

cells.en: I'm about to start the lesson.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك بدء الدرس.
cells.description: Teacher preparing to begin a lesson

cells.en: I'm about to answer the question.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك الإجابة عن السؤال.
cells.description: Learner about to answer a question

cells.en: I'm about to eat lunch.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك تناول الغداء.
cells.description: Adult seated before a freshly served lunch

cells.en: I'm about to send the email.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك إرسال الرسالة الإلكترونية.
cells.description: Adult poised to send a completed email

cells.en: I'm about to get on the bus.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك ركوب الحافلة.
cells.description: Passenger waiting at an open bus door

cells.en: I'm about to finish the last page.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك إنهاء الصفحة الأخيرة.
cells.description: Reader nearing the end of a book's final page

cells.en: I'm about to introduce our guest.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك تقديم ضيفنا.
cells.description: Host preparing to introduce a guest to a group

cells.en: I'm about to close the shop for the day.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك إغلاق المتجر لهذا اليوم.
cells.description: Shopkeeper preparing to lock up at closing time

cells.en: I'm about to make some tea; would you like a cup?
cells.ar: أنا على وشك إعداد الشاي؛ هل ترغب في كوب؟
cells.description: Host beside a kettle offering tea to a visitor

cells.en: I'm about to leave, so please tell me quickly.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك المغادرة، لذا أخبرني بسرعة من فضلك.
cells.description: Adult holding a bag at the doorway while a friend speaks

cells.en: I'm about to start the interview, and I feel nervous.
cells.ar: أنا على وشك بدء المقابلة وأشعر بالتوتر.
cells.description: Nervous applicant waiting to enter an interview room

title: إذا ... فسوف
form: If + present simple, I'll + base verb

cells.en: If it rains, I'll stay at home.
cells.ar: إذا أمطرت، فسأبقى في المنزل.
cells.description: Adult considering staying home during rain

cells.en: If I finish early, I'll call you.
cells.ar: إن انتهيت مبكرًا، سأتصل بك.
cells.description: Adult planning a call after early completion

cells.en: If you need help, I'll explain it.
cells.ar: إذا احتجت مساعدة، فسأشرح الأمر.
cells.description: Tutor offering help if a learner needs it

cells.en: If the bus is late, I'll walk.
cells.ar: إذا تأخرت الحافلة، فسأمشي.
cells.description: Passenger considering walking if a bus is late

cells.en: If the shop is open, I'll buy some bread.
cells.ar: إذا كان المتجر مفتوحًا، فسأشتري بعض الخبز.
cells.description: Shopper considering a stop at a bakery

cells.en: If I find your notebook, I'll bring it tomorrow.
cells.ar: إذا وجدت دفترك، فسأحضره غدًا.
cells.description: Classmate looking for a missing notebook

cells.en: If you send me the address, I'll check the route.
cells.ar: إذا أرسلت لي العنوان، فسأتحقق من الطريق.
cells.description: Adult preparing to check directions on a map

cells.en: If the weather improves, I'll take a walk.
cells.ar: إذا تحسن الطقس، فسأخرج للتمشّي.
cells.description: Adult watching rain ease outside a window

cells.en: If I don't understand, I'll ask another question.
cells.ar: إذا لم أفهم، فسأطرح سؤالًا آخر.
cells.description: Learner preparing to ask a tutor for clarification

cells.en: If there is enough space, I'll invite my cousin.
cells.ar: إذا كان هناك متسع، فسأدعو ابن عمي.
cells.description: Host checking available seats before inviting another guest

cells.en: If the first method doesn't work, I'll try the second one.
cells.ar: إذا لم تنجح الطريقة الأولى، فسأجرب الثانية.
cells.description: Adult comparing two ways to assemble an object

cells.en: If I arrive before you, I'll wait near the entrance.
cells.ar: إذا وصلت قبلك، فسأنتظر قرب المدخل.
cells.description: Friends agreeing on a meeting point outside a building

title: عندما ... سوف
form: When + present simple, I'll + base verb

cells.en: When I get home, I'll call my mother.
cells.ar: عندما أصل إلى المنزل، سأتصل بأمي.
cells.description: Adult planning a family call on arriving home

cells.en: When the class ends, I'll go outside.
cells.ar: عندما تنتهي الحصة، سأخرج.
cells.description: Learner waiting to go out after class

cells.en: When she arrives, I'll start the meeting.
cells.ar: عندما تصل، سأبدأ الاجتماع.
cells.description: Organizer waiting for a participant before starting a meeting

cells.en: When I save enough money, I'll buy a bike.
cells.ar: عندما أدخر ما يكفي من المال، سأشتري دراجة.
cells.description: Adult planning a bicycle purchase after saving enough

cells.en: When the bread is ready, I'll call you.
cells.ar: عندما يصبح الخبز جاهزًا، سأناديك.
cells.description: Home baker preparing to call someone when bread is done

cells.en: When I receive the receipt, I'll send you a copy.
cells.ar: عندما أتلقى الإيصال، سأرسل لك نسخة.
cells.description: Adult preparing to share a purchase receipt

cells.en: When the shop opens, I'll ask about the price.
cells.ar: عندما يفتح المتجر، سأسأل عن السعر.
cells.description: Shopper waiting outside a store before opening

cells.en: When you return the book, I'll lend it to Sara.
cells.ar: عندما تعيد الكتاب، سأعيره لسارة.
cells.description: Friends arranging the next loan of a book

cells.en: When I have a free afternoon, I'll organize these files.
cells.ar: عندما يتاح لي وقت بعد الظهر، سأرتب هذه الملفات.
cells.description: Office worker planning to sort a pile of folders

cells.en: When the visitors arrive, I'll show them the garden.
cells.ar: عندما يصل الزوار، سأريهم الحديقة.
cells.description: Host preparing to welcome visitors into a garden

cells.en: When I know the final date, I'll update the calendar.
cells.ar: عندما أعرف الموعد النهائي، سأحدث التقويم.
cells.description: Organizer waiting to confirm a calendar entry

cells.en: When I finish this course, I'll keep practicing with a friend.
cells.ar: عندما أنهي هذه الدورة، سأواصل التدريب مع صديق.
cells.description: Learner planning continued conversation practice after a course

title: فور أن ... سوف
form: As soon as + present simple, I'll + base verb

cells.en: As soon as I finish, I'll help you.
cells.ar: فور أن أنتهي، سأساعدك.
cells.description: Adult ready to help after finishing a task

cells.en: As soon as the bus arrives, I'll get on.
cells.ar: فور وصول الحافلة، سأركب.
cells.description: Passenger waiting to board an approaching bus

cells.en: As soon as I hear the news, I'll tell you.
cells.ar: فور سماعي الخبر، سأخبرك.
cells.description: Adult preparing to share news immediately

cells.en: As soon as she calls, I'll answer.
cells.ar: فور اتصالها، سأجيب.
cells.description: Adult ready to answer an expected phone call

cells.en: As soon as I reach the station, I'll buy a ticket.
cells.ar: فور وصولي إلى المحطة، سأشتري تذكرة.
cells.description: Traveller planning to use a ticket counter immediately on arrival

cells.en: As soon as the rain stops, I'll open the windows.
cells.ar: فور توقف المطر، سأفتح النوافذ.
cells.description: Adult waiting beside closed windows during rain

cells.en: As soon as I receive the file, I'll check it.
cells.ar: فور استلام الملف، سأراجعه.
cells.description: Employee waiting to review an arriving document

cells.en: As soon as you are ready, I'll start the timer.
cells.ar: فور أن تصبح مستعدًا، سأشغل المؤقت.
cells.description: Coach preparing a timer while a learner gets ready

cells.en: As soon as the shop opens, I'll collect the order.
cells.ar: فور فتح المتجر، سأستلم الطلب.
cells.description: Customer waiting to collect an order at opening time

cells.en: As soon as I find a quiet place, I'll call you back.
cells.ar: فور أن أجد مكانًا هادئًا، سأعاود الاتصال بك.
cells.description: Adult leaving a noisy area to make a call

cells.en: As soon as the lesson ends, I'll practice the new phrases.
cells.ar: فور انتهاء الدرس، سأتدرب على العبارات الجديدة.
cells.description: Learner preparing phrase notes for immediate practice

cells.en: As soon as I notice a mistake, I'll correct it.
cells.ar: فور أن ألاحظ خطأ، سأصححه.
cells.description: Adult checking work with a pencil ready to make corrections

cells.en: I feel calm after my walk.
cells.ar: أشعر بالهدوء بعد المشي.
cells.description: Adult relaxing after a walk

cells.en: I feel nervous before an exam.
cells.ar: أشعر بالتوتر قبل الامتحان.
cells.description: Learner feeling nervous before an exam

cells.en: I feel better today.
cells.ar: أشعر بتحسن اليوم.
cells.description: Adult recovering and feeling better

cells.en: I feel sad when I miss my family.
cells.ar: أشعر بالحزن عندما أشتاق إلى عائلتي.
cells.description: Adult missing family while looking at a photograph

cells.en: I feel hopeful about the new course.
cells.ar: أشعر بالتفاؤل بشأن الدورة الجديدة.
cells.description: Adult learner smiling while reviewing a new course plan

cells.en: I feel tired after carrying those boxes.
cells.ar: أشعر بالتعب بعد حمل تلك الصناديق.
cells.description: Adult resting beside recently moved boxes

cells.en: I feel comfortable asking questions here.
cells.ar: أشعر بالارتياح لطرح الأسئلة هنا.
cells.description: Confident learner asking a question in a welcoming class

cells.en: I feel responsible for keeping the room tidy.
cells.ar: أشعر بالمسؤولية عن الحفاظ على ترتيب الغرفة.
cells.description: Adult organizing a shared study room

cells.en: I feel relieved now that the interview is over.
cells.ar: أشعر بالارتياح الآن وقد انتهت المقابلة.
cells.description: Applicant relaxing after leaving an interview room

cells.en: I feel uncertain about which route to take.
cells.ar: أشعر بالتردد بشأن الطريق الذي ينبغي أن أسلكه.
cells.description: Traveller comparing two routes on a map

cells.en: I feel lucky to have such helpful neighbors.
cells.ar: أشعر بأنني محظوظ لأن لدي جيرانًا متعاونين إلى هذا الحد.
cells.description: Adult thanking neighbors who helped carry belongings

cells.en: I feel more confident when I prepare in advance.
cells.ar: أشعر بثقة أكبر عندما أستعد مسبقًا.
cells.description: Prepared speaker reviewing notes before a presentation

cells.en: I'm happy with my test result.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن نتيجة اختباري.
cells.description: Learner satisfied with a test result

cells.en: I'm happy with our new classroom.
cells.ar: أنا سعيد بفصلنا الدراسي الجديد.
cells.description: Learner admiring a new classroom

cells.en: I'm happy with the final design.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن التصميم النهائي.
cells.description: Designer approving a finished design

cells.en: I'm happy with the way we worked together.
cells.ar: أنا سعيد بالطريقة التي عملنا بها معًا.
cells.description: Team satisfied after working together

cells.en: I'm happy with the service at this hotel.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن الخدمة في هذا الفندق.
cells.description: Guest giving positive feedback at a hotel reception

cells.en: I'm happy with my choice of course.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن اختياري للدورة.
cells.description: Adult learner discussing a suitable course with a friend

cells.en: I'm happy with the amount of progress I've made.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن مقدار التقدم الذي أحرزته.
cells.description: Learner comparing earlier and recent writing samples

cells.en: I'm happy with the seats we booked.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن المقاعد التي حجزناها.
cells.description: Travellers finding their booked seats on a train

cells.en: I'm happy with our decision to start earlier.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن قرارنا أن نبدأ أبكر.
cells.description: Team reviewing a successful early start

cells.en: I'm happy with the repairs, but the room still needs painting.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن الإصلاحات، لكن الغرفة ما زالت تحتاج إلى طلاء.
cells.description: Homeowner inspecting repaired walls that still need paint

cells.en: I'm happy with the feedback my tutor gave me.
cells.ar: أنا راضٍ عن الملاحظات التي قدمها لي مدرسي.
cells.description: Learner reading constructive tutor feedback

cells.en: I'm happy with a simple meal after a busy day.
cells.ar: أرضى بوجبة بسيطة بعد يوم حافل.
cells.description: Adult enjoying a simple supper after work

title: أنا قلق بشأن
form: I'm worried about + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: I'm worried about tomorrow's exam.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن اختبار الغد.
cells.description: Learner concerned about tomorrow’s exam

cells.en: I'm worried about my friend's health.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن صحة صديقي.
cells.description: Adult concerned about a friend’s health

cells.en: I'm worried about missing the bus.
cells.ar: أنا قلق من تفويت الحافلة.
cells.description: Traveller worried about missing a bus

cells.en: I'm worried about the heavy rain.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن المطر الغزير.
cells.description: Adult observing heavy rain from indoors

cells.en: I'm worried about losing my ticket.
cells.ar: أنا قلق من فقدان تذكرتي.
cells.description: Traveller checking a ticket is safely in a pocket

cells.en: I'm worried about the noise outside.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن الضوضاء في الخارج.
cells.description: Adult listening to an unexplained noise outside a window

cells.en: I'm worried about speaking in front of a large group.
cells.ar: أنا قلق من التحدث أمام مجموعة كبيرة.
cells.description: Nervous speaker looking toward a meeting room

cells.en: I'm worried about our neighbor, who lives alone.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن جارنا الذي يعيش وحده.
cells.description: Adult preparing to check on an elderly neighbor

cells.en: I'm worried about arriving after the office closes.
cells.ar: أنا قلق من الوصول بعد إغلاق المكتب.
cells.description: Traveller comparing traffic with an office closing time

cells.en: I'm worried about the condition of the old roof.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن حالة السقف القديم.
cells.description: Homeowner inspecting a worn roof from a safe position

cells.en: I'm worried about making the same mistake again.
cells.ar: أنا قلق من ارتكاب الخطأ نفسه مجددًا.
cells.description: Learner carefully reviewing a corrected exercise

cells.en: I'm worried about how little time we have left.
cells.ar: أنا قلق بشأن قلة الوقت المتبقي لنا.
cells.description: Project team checking a deadline beside unfinished work

title: أنا فخور بـ
form: I'm proud of + person or achievement

cells.en: I'm proud of my sister's success.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بنجاح أختي.
cells.description: Adult celebrating a sister’s achievement

cells.en: I'm proud of our team.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بفريقنا.
cells.description: Team member praising a team’s effort

cells.en: I'm proud of my progress in English.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بتقدمي في الإنجليزية.
cells.description: Learner recognizing English progress

cells.en: I'm proud of you for trying again.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بك لأنك حاولت مجددًا.
cells.description: Adult encouraging someone who tried again

cells.en: I'm proud of the care you put into this work.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بالعناية التي بذلتها في هذا العمل.
cells.description: Teacher praising carefully completed learner work

cells.en: I'm proud of my first complete conversation in English.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بأول محادثة كاملة أجريتها بالإنجليزية.
cells.description: Learner celebrating a successful conversation with a tutor

cells.en: I'm proud of the volunteers who organized the event.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بالمتطوعين الذين نظموا الفعالية.
cells.description: Organizer congratulating volunteers after an event

cells.en: I'm proud of our decision to keep trying.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بقرارنا مواصلة المحاولة.
cells.description: Team returning confidently to a difficult task

cells.en: I'm proud of my son for helping his classmates.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بابني لمساعدته زملاءه.
cells.description: Parent praising a child for helping classmates

cells.en: I'm proud of the garden we created together.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بالحديقة التي أنشأناها معًا.
cells.description: Neighbors admiring a garden they planted together

cells.en: I'm proud of myself for asking when I didn't understand.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بنفسي لأنني سألت عندما لم أفهم.
cells.description: Learner reflecting positively after asking for clarification

cells.en: I'm proud of the improvement, even though I still make mistakes.
cells.ar: أنا فخور بالتحسن رغم أنني ما زلت أرتكب أخطاء.
cells.description: Learner comparing improved work with a few remaining corrections

cells.en: I'm surprised that you remember my name.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ لأنك تتذكر اسمي.
cells.description: Adult surprised someone remembers a name

cells.en: I'm surprised that the shop is open.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن المتجر مفتوح.
cells.description: Shopper surprised to find an open shop

cells.en: I'm surprised that he finished so early.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأنه انتهى مبكرًا جدًا.
cells.description: Colleague surprised by early task completion

cells.en: I'm surprised that this book is so interesting.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن هذا الكتاب ممتع جدًا.
cells.description: Reader enjoying an unexpectedly interesting book

cells.en: I'm surprised that the room is already full.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن الغرفة امتلأت بالفعل.
cells.description: Adult surprised by a crowded room on arrival

cells.en: I'm surprised that you found the key so quickly.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ لأنك وجدت المفتاح بهذه السرعة.
cells.description: Adult reacting to a friend finding a lost key

cells.en: I'm surprised that the trip cost so little.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن الرحلة كلفت القليل إلى هذا الحد.
cells.description: Traveller pleasantly surprised by a low fare receipt

cells.en: I'm surprised that she speaks three languages.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأنها تتحدث ثلاث لغات.
cells.description: Adult listening with interest to a multilingual speaker

cells.en: I'm surprised that nobody asked about the deadline.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ لأن أحدًا لم يسأل عن الموعد النهائي.
cells.description: Meeting participant reacting to an unasked scheduling question

cells.en: I'm surprised that the old camera still works.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن آلة التصوير القديمة ما زالت تعمل.
cells.description: Adult testing an old camera with a surprised smile

cells.en: I'm surprised that we have so much in common.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ بكثرة الأمور المشتركة بيننا.
cells.description: New friends discovering shared interests over coffee

cells.en: I'm surprised that I understood the whole conversation.
cells.ar: أنا متفاجئ لأنني فهمت المحادثة كاملة.
cells.description: Language learner reacting happily after understanding a conversation

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the game was canceled.
cells.ar: أنا محبط لأن المباراة أُلغيت.
cells.description: Player hearing that a game is canceled

cells.en: I'm disappointed that we lost the match.
cells.ar: أنا محبط لأننا خسرنا المباراة.
cells.description: Team member disappointed after a match

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the package is late.
cells.ar: أنا محبط لأن الطرد تأخر.
cells.description: Adult waiting for a delayed package

cells.en: I'm disappointed that I missed the concert.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن الحفل الموسيقي فاتني.
cells.description: Adult looking regretfully at an unused concert ticket

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the library is closed today.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن المكتبة مغلقة اليوم.
cells.description: Reader disappointed outside a closed library

cells.en: I'm disappointed that you can't join us.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأنك لا تستطيع الانضمام إلينا.
cells.description: Adult hearing that a friend cannot attend a gathering

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the repair didn't solve the problem.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن الإصلاح لم يحل المشكلة.
cells.description: Adult inspecting an appliance that still does not work

cells.en: I'm disappointed that we ran out of time.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن وقتنا نفد.
cells.description: Learners looking at an unfinished project as time ends

cells.en: I'm disappointed that I forgot her birthday.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل من نفسي لأنني نسيت عيد ميلادها.
cells.description: Adult realizing a friend's birthday was missed

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the room wasn't ready when we arrived.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن الغرفة لم تكن جاهزة عند وصولنا.
cells.description: Hotel guests waiting with luggage for an unready room

cells.en: I'm disappointed that we didn't get more useful feedback.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأننا لم نحصل على ملاحظات أكثر فائدة.
cells.description: Team reviewing very limited feedback after a presentation

cells.en: I'm disappointed that the course ended before I could finish the project.
cells.ar: أشعر بخيبة أمل لأن الدورة انتهت قبل أن أتمكن من إنهاء المشروع.
cells.description: Learner looking at unfinished course project materials
